name: Altered Ego
oracle_text:
This spell can't be countered.
You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it enters with X additional +1/+1 counters on it.
blocked_sentences: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it enters with X additional +1/+1 counters on it.

needs.what: the `self_enters_as_copy` replacement's `except_.enters_with` entries must evaluate their `amount` with the X announced when the permanent was cast (obj.cast_x), so `{"amount": {"x": true}, "counter": "+1/+1"}` puts X counters on the copy as it enters
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `self_enters_as_copy` with `except_.enters_with` exists (Spark Double), but `move_object` in engine/zones.py evaluates each entry with an EffectContext built without `x=obj.cast_x`, so `{"x": true}` silently evaluates to 0 and the copy enters with no counters. The separate `self_enters_with_counters` replacement does read cast_x, but it applies whether or not a copy is chosen, so a non-copied Altered Ego would survive as a 0/0 with X counters -- a different card
needs.suggested_fix: pass `x=obj.cast_x` to the EffectContext built in the `except_.enters_with` loop of `move_object`
